statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was based on missing prior authorization
The patient has recurrent syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
There is concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or symptomatic arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate transient symptoms with underlying rhythm disturbances and guide further management
